title: Leak Search Share by Failed Component, Harbison Parts-and-Labor Protection Tiers
content:
On a refrigerant-circuit claim against a Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection, Harbison 12-Year Total Protection or Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, on a tier that covers the leak search, the leak search paid is the leak search net times the leak-search share. The share follows the failed component named on the claim.

| Failed component | Leak-search share |
|---|---|
| compressor | 0.50 |
| metering device (TXV) or reversing valve | 0.75 |
| any other component | the tier's own leak-search coverage: one where the tier covers the leak search, zero where it does not |

The leak search net is the line billed under the refrigerant leak search task on the claim's service call, less the member repair discount posted against it. The refrigerant circuit comprises the compressor, the condenser coil, the evaporator coil, the metering device and the reversing valve.

**Cases (hypothetical, leak search net $240.00, tier covering the leak search).**

| Failed component | Share | Leak search paid |
|---|---|---|
| compressor | 0.50 | $120.00 |
| reversing valve | 0.75 | $180.00 |
| TXV metering device | 0.75 | $180.00 |
| condenser coil | one | $240.00 |
